_help: Transparency report on support.html (#where). 'goal' is the monthly target in euros (keep it equal to the Ko-fi goal). Add one entry to 'months' after each month closes: received = total from Ko-fi that month, spent = what was paid out that month (running costs + development time), split per category in 'spent_by' (keys from 'covers'). Use whole euros. The reserve is calculated. Then run python tools/website/build.py.
